$comment: The Synchromy patch register. The ONLY list of what cosmic/<lane> carries on top of upstream. scripts/cosmic-patches.ts reads it to rebuild, verify and check upstream; test/cosmic-patches.test.ts proves every patch is present. See PATCHES.md for the why.

patches.what: sources set-id: a source's identity, changed safely
a filter the engine honours that no op exposes is a bug (contract test)

patches.what: an embedder outage (401/402/403, key limit, 429 after one capped retry, 5xx, refused connection) lands a put_page write without its embedding, marked in cosmic_embed_waiting; `gbrain embed --waiting` catches it up and get_health counts the marked pages. A dimension mismatch, oversize payload or bad input still throws

upstream.note: carried patch, not offered upstream: it relaxes upstream's deliberate no-silent-unembedded-pages rule (Codex C2), which holds here only because the waiting pages are counted and drained

patches.hub_uses: the reconcile-loop catch-up tick and the dashboard's waiting banner (C-19, add-write-queue-for-outages), not yet written

patches.what: a remote put_page/capture whose target source is not restricted, onto a slug that exists in restricted, is refused naming the restricted page; local writes and remote writes to a slug shared by visible sources are untouched

upstream.note: carried patch, not offered upstream: the restricted source is Cosmic's member-level model (C-72)

patches.hub_uses: every admin agent's /mcp put_page on a company Cosmic (C-72, add-restricted-content, finding 6)

patches.what: a scoped list_link_sources counts an edge only when both its endpoints are in the caller's scope, so a member-level client's counts carry no edge into restricted; unscoped local callers are unchanged

upstream.note: never offered upstream: a cross-source count in upstream's own scoping, found by the C-72 member read sweep; offering it is a person's call

patches.hub_uses: every member-level client's list_link_sources on a company Cosmic (C-72, add-restricted-content, finding 8)

patches.what: `gbrain pages move-source <slug> <to> [--from <source>]` moves one page between engine sources in one transaction, keeping its id (chunks, versions, links, raw data and timeline follow it) and re-keying its page-local source rows; refused onto any row already at the destination slug; a schema walk fails on a source_id table it does not decide about

upstream.note: carried patch, not offered upstream: the restricted source is Cosmic's member-level model (C-72)

patches.hub_uses: clearing a restriction on a company Cosmic moves the page back to its visible source (C-72, add-restricted-content, finding 6)

patches.what: the advisor reports on the whole brain, so a remote caller whose read grant does not cover every source is refused it (permission_denied, naming no source); trusted local callers and grants covering every source are unchanged

upstream.note: carried patch, not offered upstream: the restricted source is Cosmic's member-level model (C-72)

patches.hub_uses: every member-level client's advisor call on a company Cosmic (C-72, add-restricted-content, finding 8)

patches.what: what the engine derives takes no input from the `restricted` source, nor from `founders`, which starts restricted (C-72 finding 10): the facts and chronicle backstops and their workers, extract_facts and the raw-turn facts pipeline (runFactsPipeline), extract_entities, the meeting timeline fan-out, the patterns phase's reflections, the per-source loops of conversation_facts_backfill and enrich_thin, consolidate's all-source facts scan, and a cycle run for restricted skip it; a restricted page keeps its own links, timeline and embedding

upstream.note: carried patch, not offered upstream: the restricted source is Cosmic's member-level model (C-72)

patches.hub_uses: none called: the hub lands restricted pages with gbrain capture into source restricted, and this keeps them out of facts, people and company pages (C-72, add-restricted-content, finding 9)

patches.what: remember resolves its entity through the entity verb's resolution (alias > exact slug > exact title > slug-suffix; a title or suffix match only on a person, company, organization, entity or project page), then the facts resolver's name arms, and refuses an entity that matches no page (not_found, entity_not_found, nearest pages in the suggestion and as JSON in detail) instead of filing the fact under a slug no page has; entity's miss suggestions put title and slug matches (resolve_slugs, plus the last slug segment) ahead of content matches

upstream.note: carried patch, not offered upstream yet: upstream master (v0.60.65.0) still files an explicit pageless entity database-only with no warning (persistence/memory-mutations.ts planRememberTarget), so it is upstream-bound once Neel decides

patches.hub_uses: remember: every connected agent's remember call; hub writers ingest/dated-facts-store.ts, serve/onboarding/complete.ts and serve/research-tools.ts pass slugs of pages that exist, serve/attribution-tools.ts copies the corrected fact's entity

patches.what: put_page (and capture, which delegates to it) returns outcome (created | updated | unchanged), embed_tokens and embed_cost_usd for the indexing the write caused, and serve-http's success insert merges those three into the mcp_request_log row's params; status is unchanged and params was already jsonb, so no migration. embed_tokens is the engine's per-chunk estimate (content_chunks.token_count), priced at the configured embedding model's rate

upstream.note: carried patch, not offered upstream: the request-log usage fields serve Cosmic's usage ledger

patches.hub_uses: none called yet: the hub's usage ledger reads mcp_request_log.params outcome/embed_tokens/embed_cost_usd once its engine pin moves (cosmic-hub #1477, decision 1)

patches.what: Cosmic's name on what the engine tells a connected agent and the public: handshake, tool descriptions, hints, server and resource names, new credential prefixes (cosmic_). Inert unless COSMIC_BRAND is set

upstream.note: ours by design: Synchromy's product name, never upstream (Synchromy/cosmic-hub#691)

patches.hub_uses: every connected agent; switched on by COSMIC_BRAND in the hub image

register sanity and one presence probe per patch

raw data resolves by (source_id, slug) and never falls back to another source's page: a contract the restricted source relies on (C-72, finding 3)
every read op, as a member-level client, shows nothing from restricted or founders in any answer or count: the sweep the restricted source relies on (C-72, finding 8)
the cosmic-brand patch: wires brand.ts into the engine
the lane's own CI gate; upstream's workflows run on master only (finding unattached#25)
